scope: Native CPU numerical parity and worker-affinity candidate matrix; no throughput claim.

topology.mutation_policy: read-only; no affinity, priority, power, or process state changed
topology.classification_basis: windows EfficiencyClass ordering (higher class first; P/E names unverified)

all.classification_basis: windows EfficiencyClass ordering (higher class first; P/E names unverified)

auto.classification_basis: windows EfficiencyClass ordering (higher class first; P/E names unverified)

p-cores.classification_basis: windows EfficiencyClass ordering (higher class first; P/E names unverified)

label_caveat: EfficiencyClass values and CPU-set IDs are recorded as measured. P/E/LP labels are unverified; pool-affinity-p-cores is an upstream heuristic name only.

candidate_semantics.all: OS candidate order; if requested workers exceed candidates, overflow is unpinned
candidate_semantics.auto: numeric EfficiencyClass heuristic order only; overflow unpinned
candidate_semantics.p-cores: strict candidate limit; cases above five candidate worker IDs are NOT RUN
